steps.name: Receber a ordem
steps.task: Restate the order and who gave it. Only trader-analyst, trader-strategist or trader-hunter may give one. Never touch the raw sheet.

steps.name: Executar
steps.task: Write and format the sheet exactly as ordered. List every range changed.

steps.name: Verificar padrões
steps.task: Confirm the house standards: frozen dark header row, banded ranges, pure numbers formatted pt_PT, right-aligned currency, centred dates.

steps.name: Relatório
steps.task: Give the technical execution report, for example "columns A-G created, formatting applied".
